GetHR.description: Returns the height radius of the arc.

GetStartAngle.description: Returns the start angle of the arc.

GetSweepAngle.description: Returns the sweep angle of the arc.

GetType.description: Returns the type of the current path command.

GetWR.description: Returns the width radius of the arc.

GetX.description: Returns the X coordinate for the "moveTo"/"lineTo" path commands.

GetX0.description: Returns the X coordinate of the first control point for the Bezier curves.

GetX1.description: Returns the X coordinate of the second control point for the cubic Bezier curves.

GetX2.description: Returns the X coordinate of the end point for the cubic Bezier curves.

GetY.description: Returns the Y coordinate for the "moveTo"/"lineTo" path commands.

GetY0.description: Returns the Y coordinate of the first control point for the Bezier curves.

GetY1.description: Returns the Y coordinate of the second control point for the cubic Bezier curves.

GetY2.description: Returns the Y coordinate of the end point for the cubic Bezier curves.
